FP8_candidates.mechanism: Independent held-out BF16 calibration: clipping counts, error at fixed original scales; only calibration chooses one candidate scale recipe. No formal-label feedback.
Split single-query decode rows from mixed paged prefill to supported XQA; retain official scheduling and GDN semantics; benchmark operator overhead before service.
If profile identifies material query/writer cost, bounded fusion using mature kernel; no independent attention rewrite.

stop: Reject unsupported or incorrect kernels before large workloads; at most one frozen final candidate per direction; retain all failures; no post-quality-answer retuning. MXFP4 service only after real supported attention qualification.

quality_gate.classification: Agent engineering thresholds, not user-approved SLO or statistical noninferiority claim
quality_gate.intervals: Report paired bootstrap confidence intervals and discordant task counts; uncertain intervals stay inconclusive; no declaration of statistical noninferiority from point thresholds.

agentic: CPU screen one useful trace; skip GPU if no meaningful KV capacity pressure; distinguish trace replay and live tools.
